requirements.coverage: Injected dependencies, UTC time, atomic CAS and separate service instances
Tenant/permission first, strict inputs, opaque error results
Foreign/malformed snapshot validation before any use or ID generation
Tenant-wide exact-payload submission replay and atomic job/key creation
Ordering, availability, fresh permanent lease IDs and atomic ownership
Current lease authorization, expiry boundary and settlement state changes
Exact historical replay and cross-operation/delay conflicts
Third failure/expiry terminal, skip exhausted and commit cleanup with claim
Fresh conflict recovery, bounded retries, atomic writes and no exception retry
Immutable constructors, detached snapshots and unrelated record preservation

negative_controls.defect: Remove tenant equality from permission authorization
negative_controls.failure_kind: Unauthorized operation proceeds to store instead of denial before dependencies

negative_controls.defect: Ignore current lease ID when settling
negative_controls.failure_kind: Expired old lease can settle same-worker replacement lease

negative_controls.defect: Return proposed result even when CAS reports false
negative_controls.failure_kind: Reports uncommitted success or stale result

negative_controls.defect: Do not exhaust expired third lease
negative_controls.failure_kind: Fourth attempt replaces required terminal state and skip/cleanup

limits: No UI, mobile, persistence-engine, real worker execution or distributed-clock evaluation.
Editable-file/dependency scope and non-print logging side effects require runner evidence or independent review in addition to value assertions.
Preliminary author checks do not establish independent qualification, pilot difficulty or confirmation sample size.
question_policy: All initial policies are specified. No scripted product answer is required.

revision_changes.change: Capture output and reject protected payload/backend/clock/ID-source marker content. Benign fixed diagnostic messages remain allowed.
Count clock, job-ID and lease-ID invocations independently of generated values. Assert zero store/clock/ID calls after every denied or invalid path for all four operations.

preliminary_probes.clock_before_guard: must fail J01-T01 and J01-T02 by counters

revision_changes.change: Remove N03 unreachable retry wrapper and busy return. It still performs one CAS and returns the proposed outcome regardless of CAS false. No oracle/public/reference change.
